briefdescription.para: VT action dispatch, UTF-8 accumulation, and CSI parameter helpers.

detaileddescription.para: This translation unit implements Parser::performAction(), Parser::performEntryAction(), the UTF-8 byte accumulation path, and the buffer append primitive. The hot-path loop and state transition machinery live in Parser.cpp.

entry.para: video.applyControlCode() — C0 control characters (CR, LF, BS, …)
video.storeDCSHeader() — DCS sequence entry, records final byte
video.applyDCSPayload() — DCS sequence exit, dispatches accumulated payload

para.bold: All methods in this file are READER THREAD only.

simplesect.para: Parser.h — class declaration, member documentation, and lifecycle notes
Parser.cpp — hot-path loop and state transition machinery
Video.h — VT command processor called directly for all semantic actions
